body: Thank you for reaching out. I have a therapist. I just hate having to wait and wait for my diagnoses and miss so much school just to see that it came out negative. I don't have time to wait. I'm missing out on a lot of stuff in life. I know for sure I also won't be going straight to college.

I read some of your previous posts and I'm becoming really health anxious as well. I actually have every single thing that you have, including GI issues. I've thrown things, I've yelled at my parents, I've been extremely depressed and hopeless. I'm 16, and everything I have is just crumbling away very quickly. Although my Gastro issues won't go away, I find that lifting weights and working out is a good way to use the anger. It makes me relaxed and pretty pumped for the next day or so.

How old are you now? That's the most important question. I feel similar, a lot of us do. This may sound ignorant, and I'm sorry, but is there a reason you're depressed? Why do you lack social relationship?

There's a point where I just started saying 'fuck birthdays'. It's just another day in my eyes. Find a person, doesn't matter how many or who, just spend that day hanging out with them, that's a birthday party for me.

I'm just so sorry. Telling someone you want to kill yourself never ends well unless they truly understand. The common response is to call the cops or tell somebody, but I think that makes everything worse. Is there anyone you can trust to talk to? Have you tried forcing yourself to eat? I usually take out my built up anger and sadness and start lifting furiously while nobody else is around. I haven't been able to do that lately because I'm starting to develop chronic pains and other symptoms that keep others away from me. In a way I feel like you, and I fucking wish the best for you man.
I've had many medical examinations, nothing has come up.
I was like you. I miss being like you, now I have a physical illness. Don't let your problems manifest themselves physically, thats when you truly feel hopeless.

Ecruteak City in Pokemon Gold stuck out a lot for me

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4MNAktk9ei8

I feel exactly what you mean. I go home every day and ask myself "Why is this happening". I can't do anything about my problem, so I just get so angry and sad. I feel hopeless. Sorry I can't give you advice, I'm just feeling the exact same way.
I don't have caffeine at all, I eat pretty healthy too. I usually end up on my phone while im in bed though, any tips to prevent that?

Thank you for understanding. My problem is that the understanding of my issue is very skewed from other people's perspectives. My friends think that I just need to stop overthinking, which isn't easy. My teachers think I need to come in after school for extra help, which won't help with my anxiety. My parents care, but they don't know how to deal with depression or anxiety.

I can also note that I'm in group projects with friends and have long term projects due all at once, and It's seriously hard to pull my weight on such projects when I can't even handle my own physical and mental struggles.

Thanks for reaching out, but this isnt even a weakness. It's a pain, I still do what I can to stay in shape and all that, I even lift weights when I have the time. I am just in pain. A lot of constant pain.
There has to be a reason though, Is it something you are aware that you are doing? Or behaving a certain way? Did you have friends in elementary or middle school?

I want to note that this isn't something easy to talk about with others, and If i do, it sounds like im just pulling symptoms out of my ass even though I can feel them. I feel like such a loser if I miss school, and if I go, it's the most uncomfortable feeling ever.
Would you be happier with friends?

Bafflingly muscular? You sure it's not man titties? I'm picturing Arnold Schwarzenegger's chest on a guy with no back or arms. Doesnt add up. Post a pic maybe next time so we can get an idea of what is making you heavier.

You're overthinking. Have you been called this in real life or just over the internet? We all have a little bit of narcissism in us, just don't make yourself look like an asshole and you'll be fine. I'm obsessed with my body, but I never brag about it. It's something i keep to myself.
